paragraphs.sourceText: Intolerance is the art of ignoring any views that differ from your own. It 26 itself in hatred, stereotypes, prejudice, and 27 Once it intensifies in people, intolerance is nearly impossible to overcome. But why would anyone want to be labeled intolerant? Why would people want to be 28 about the world around them? Why would one want to be part of the problem in America, instead of the solution?

There are many explanations for intolerant attitudes, some 29 childhood. It is likely that intolerant folks grew up 30 intolerant parents and the cycle of prejudice has simply continued for 31 . Perhaps intolerant people are so set in their ways that they find it easier to ignore anything that might not 32 their limited view of life. Or maybe intolerant students have simply never been 33 to anyone different from themselves. But none of these reasons is an excuse for allowing the intolerance to continue.

Intolerance should not be confused with disagreement. It is, of course, possible to disagree with an opinion without being intolerant of it/If you understand a belief but still don’t believe in that specific belief, that’s fine. You are 34 your opinion. As a matter of fact, 35 dissenters(持异议者) are important for any belief. If we all believed the same things, we would never grow? and we would never learn about the world around us. Intolerance does not stem from disagreement. It stems from fear. And fear stems from ignorance.

their growth. The Prince was being humorous —“My sense of humor will get me into trouble one day,“ he said to his aids（随从） —but listening to Charles Windsor can indeed prove stimulating. The royal 37 has been promoting radical ideas for most of his adult life. Some of his 38 ，which once sounded a bit weird, were simply ahead of their time. Now, finally, the world seems to be catching up with him.

Take his views on farming. Prince Charles’ Duchy Home Farm went 39 back in 1986, when most shoppers cared only about the low price tag on suspiciously blemish-free(无瑕戚的）vegetables and 40 large chickens piled high in supermarkets.
His warnings on climate change proved farsighted, too. Charles began 41 action on global warming in 1990 and says he has been worried about the 42 of man on the environment since he was a teenager.

Although he has gradually gained international 43 as one of the world’s leading conservationists, many British people still think of him as an 44 person who talks to plants. This year, as it happens, South Korean scientists proved that plants really do 45 to sound. So Charles was ahead of the game there, too. 注意：此部分试题请在答题卡2 上作答。

paragraphs.sourceText: High School Sports Aren’t Killing Academics
paragraphs.translationZh: 高中体育运动并没有扼杀学术成就

paragraphs.sourceText: A) In this months Atlantic cover article, “The Case Against High-School Sports,” Amanda Ripley argues that school-sponsored sports programs should be seriously cut. She writes that, unlike most countries that outperform the United States on international assessments, American schools put too much of an emphasis on athletics. “Sports are embedded in American schools in a way they are not almost anywhere else，” she writes. “Yet this difference hardly ever comes up in domestic debates about America’s international mediocrity (平庸) in education.”
paragraphs.translationZh: A) 在本月《大西洋月刊》的封面文章《反对高中体育的案例》中，阿曼达·里普利 (Amanda Ripley) 认为，应该严重削减学校赞助的体育项目。她写道，与大多数在国际评估中表现优于美国的国家不同，美国学校过于重视体育运动。 “体育运动深深植根于美国学校，这是其他地方几乎没有的，”她写道。 “然而，在有关美国教育水平在国际上平庸的国内争论中，这种差异几乎从未出现过。”

paragraphs.sourceText: B) American student-athletes reap many benefits from participating in sports, but the costs to the schools could outweigh their benefits, she argues. In particular, Ripley contends that sports crowd out the academic missions of schools：America should learn from South Korea and Finland and every other country at the top level of international test scores, all of whom emphasize athletics far less in school. “Even in eighth grade, American kids spend more than twice the time Korean kids spend playing sports，” she writes, citing a 2010 study published in the Journal of Advanced Academics.
paragraphs.translationZh: B）她认为，美国学生运动员从参加体育运动中获得了很多好处，但学校的成本可能超过了他们的收益。里普利特别指出，体育挤占了学校的学术使命：美国应该向韩国、芬兰以及其他国际考试成绩最高的国家学习，这些国家在学校里对体育的重视程度要低得多。 “即使在八年级，美国孩子花在体育上的时间也是韩国孩子的两倍多，”她写道，并引用了 2010 年发表在《高级学术杂志》上的一项研究。

paragraphs.sourceText: C) It might well be true that sports are far more rooted in American high schools than in other countries. But our reading of international test scores finds no support for the argument against school athletics. Indeed, our own research and that of others lead us to make the opposite case. School-sponsored sports appear to provide benefits that seem to increase, not detract (减少)from, academic success.
paragraphs.translationZh: C) 体育运动在美国高中的根基比在其他国家要深得多，这很可能是事实。但我们对国际考试成绩的解读没有发现反对学校体育的论点的支持。事实上，我们自己和其他人的研究使我们得出相反的结论。学校赞助的体育运动似乎提供了似乎增加而不是减少学业成功的好处。

paragraphs.sourceText: D) Ripley indulges a popular obsession (痴迷) with international test score comparisons,which show wide and frightening gaps between the United States and other countries. She ignores, however, the fact that states vary at least as much in test scores as do developed countries. A 2011 report from Harvard University shows that Massachusetts produces math scores comparable to South Korea and Finland, while Mississippi scores are closer to Trinidad and Tobago. Ripley’s thesis about sports falls apart in light of this fact. Schools in Massachusetts provide sports programs while schools in Finland do not. Schools in Mississippi may love football while in Tobago interscholastic sports are nowhere near as prominent. Sports cannot explain
paragraphs.translationZh: D) Ripley 沉迷于国际考试成绩比较，这显示了美国和其他国家之间巨大而可怕的差距。然而，她忽略了这样一个事实：各州的考试成绩差异至少与发达国家一样大。哈佛大学 2011 年的一份报告显示，马萨诸塞州的数学成绩与韩国和芬兰相当，而密西西比州的成绩则更接近特立尼达和多巴哥。鉴于这一事实，里普利关于体育的论文就站不住脚了。马萨诸塞州的学校提供​​体育课程，而芬兰的学校则不提供。密西西比州的学校可能热爱足球，而多巴哥的校际运动却远没有那么突出。体育无法解释

paragraphs.sourceText: these similarities in performance. They can’t explain international differences either.
paragraphs.translationZh: 这些性能上的相似之处。他们也无法解释国际差异。

paragraphs.sourceText: E) If it is true that sports undermine the academic mission of American schools, we would expect to see a negative relationship between the commitment to athletics and academic achievement. However, the University of Arkansas’s Daniel Bowen and Jay Greene actually find the opposite. They examine this relationship by analyzing schools’ sports winning percentages as well as student-athletic participation rates compared to graduation rates and standardized test score achievement over a five-year period for all public high schools in Ohio. Controlling for student poverty levels, demographics(人口统计4 大况）， and district financial resources, both measures of a school’s commitment to athletics are significantly and positively related to lower dropout rates as well as higher test scores.
paragraphs.translationZh: E）如果体育运动确实破坏了美国学校的学术使命，我们预计对体育运动的投入与学业成绩之间会出现负相关。然而，阿肯色大学的丹尼尔·鲍文和杰伊·格林却发现了相反的结果。他们通过分析俄亥俄州所有公立高中五年内学校的体育获胜百分比以及学生体育参与率与毕业率和标准化考试成绩的比较来研究这种关系。控制了学生贫困水平、人口统计数据（人口统计4大状况）和地区财政资源，学校对体育的投入的两项指标都与较低的辍学率和较高的考试成绩显着正相关。

paragraphs.sourceText: F) On-the-field success and high participation in sports is not random —it requires focus and dedication to athletics. One might think this would lead schools obsessed with winning to deemphasize academics. Bowen and Greene’s results contradict that argument. A likely explanation for this seemingly counterintuitive (与直觉相反的）result is that success in sports programs actually facilitates or rejects greater social capital within a school’s community.
paragraphs.translationZh: F) 场上的成功和体育运动的高参与度并不是随机的——它需要对体育运动的专注和奉献。人们可能会认为这会导致痴迷于获胜的学校不再重视学术。鲍文和格林的结果与这一论点相矛盾。对于这个看似违反直觉的结果的一个可能的解释是，体育项目的成功实际上促进或拒绝了学校社区内更大的社会资本。

paragraphs.sourceText: G) Ripley cites the writings of renowned sociologist James Coleman, whose research in education was groundbreaking. Coleman in his early work held athletics in contempt, arguing that they crowded out schools’ academic missions. Ripley quotes his 1961 study, The Adolescent Society, where Coleman writes, “Altogether, the trophy（奖品）case would suggest to the innocent visitor that he was entering an athletic club, not an educational institution.
paragraphs.translationZh: G) 里普利引用了著名社会学家詹姆斯·科尔曼的著作，他在教育方面的研究具有开创性。科尔曼在他的早期著作中蔑视体育运动，认为体育运动挤占了学校的学术使命。里普利引用了他 1961 年的研究《青少年社会》，其中科尔曼写道：“总而言之，奖品盒会向无辜的访客表明他正在进入一个体育俱乐部，而不是一个教育机构。

paragraphs.sourceText: H) However, in later research Coleman would show how the success of schools is highly dependent on what he termed social capital, “the norms, the social networks, and the relationships between adults and children that are of value for the child’s growing up. ”
paragraphs.translationZh: H）然而，在后来的研究中，科尔曼将表明学校的成功如何高度依赖于他所说的社会资本，“对孩子成长有价值的规范、社交网络以及成人和儿童之间的关系。 ”

paragraphs.sourceText: I) According to a 2013 evaluation conducted by the Crime Lab at the University of Chicago, a program called Becoming a Mari—Sports Edition creates lasting improvements in the boys’ study habits and grade point averages. During the first year of the program, students were found to be less likely to transfer schools or be engaged in violent crime. A year after the program, participants were less likely to have had an encounter with the juvenile justice system.
paragraphs.translationZh: I) 根据芝加哥大学犯罪实验室 2013 年进行的一项评估，一项名为“成为马里运动版”的计划对男孩的学习习惯和平均成绩产生了持久的改善。在该计划的第一年，发现学生转学或从事暴力犯罪的可能性较小。项目结束一年后，参与者接触少年司法系统的可能性降低了。

paragraphs.sourceText: J) If school-sponsored sports were completely eliminated tomorrow, many American students would still have opportunities to participate in organized athletics elsewhere, much like they do in countries such as Finland, Germany, and South Korea. The same is not certain when it comes to students from more disadvantaged backgrounds. In an overview of the research on non-school based after-school programs, researchers find that disadvantaged children participate in these programs at significantly lower rates. They find that low-income students have less access due to challenges with regard to transportation, non-nominal fees, and off-campus safety. Therefore, reducing or eliminating these opportunities would most likely deprive disadvantaged students of the benefits from athletic participation, not least of which is the opportunity to interact with positive role models outside of regular school hours.
paragraphs.translationZh: J) 如果学校主办的体育运动明天被完全取消，许多美国学生仍然有机会参加其他地方有组织的体育运动，就像他们在芬兰、德国和韩国等国家所做的那样。对于来自弱势背景的学生来说，情况就不一定了。在对非学校课外项目的研究概述中，研究人员发现弱势儿童参与这些项目的比例明显较低。他们发现，由于交通、非名义费用和校外安全方面的挑战，低收入学生的入学机会较少。因此，减少或消除这些机会很可能会剥夺弱势学生参与体育运动的好处，尤其是在正常上课时间之外与积极榜样互动的机会。

paragraphs.sourceText: K) Another unfounded criticism that Ripley makes is bringing up the stereotype that athletic coaches are typically lousy (蹩脚的） classroom teachers. “American principals, unlike the vast majority of principals around the world, make many hiring decisions with their sports teams in mind, which does not always end well for students.” she writes. Educators who seek employment at schools primarily for the purpose of coaching are likely to shirk (推卸) teaching responsibilities, the argument goes. Moreover, even in the cases where the employee is a teacher first and athletic coach second, the additional responsibilities that come with coaching likely come at the expense of time otherwise spent on planning, grading, and communicating with parents and guardians.
paragraphs.translationZh: K) 里普利提出的另一个毫无根据的批评是提出了一种刻板印象，即体育教练通常是蹩脚的课堂教师。她写道：“与世界上绝大多数校长不同，美国校长在做出许多招聘决定时都会考虑到他们的运动队，这对学生来说并不总是有好结果。”这种观点认为，主要以教练为目的在学校寻求就业的教育工作者很可能会推卸教学责任。此外，即使在这种情况下，如果员工首先是教师，其次是体育教练，那么辅导带来的额外责任可能会以牺牲原本用于计划、评分以及与家长和监护人沟通的时间为代价。

paragraphs.sourceText: L) The data, however, do not seem to confirm this stereotype. In the most rigorous study on the classroom results of high school coaches, the University of Arkansas’s Anna Egalite finds that athletic coaches in Florida mostly tend to perform just as well as their non-coaching counterparts, with respect to raising student test scores. We do not doubt that teachers who also coach face serious tradeoffs that likely come at the expense of time they could dedicate to their academic obligations. However, as with sporting events, athletic coaches gain additional opportunities for communicating and serving as mentors ( 导师）that potentially help students succeed and make up for the costs of coaching commitments.
paragraphs.translationZh: L) 然而，数据似乎并没有证实这种刻板印象。阿肯色大学的安娜·埃加利特在对高中教练的课堂成绩进行的最严格的研究中发现，在提高学生考试成绩方面，佛罗里达州的体育教练大多表现得与非教练同行一样好。我们毫不怀疑，同时担任教练的教师面临着严重的权衡，这可能会以牺牲他们可以投入学术义务的时间为代价。然而，与体育赛事一样，体育教练获得了额外的沟通和担任导师（导师）的机会，这有可能帮助学生取得成功并弥补教练承诺的成本。

paragraphs.sourceText: M) If schools allow student-athletes to regularly miss out on instructional time for the sake of traveling to athletic competitions, that’s bad. However, such issues would be better addressed by changing school and state policies with regard to the scheduling of sporting events as opposed to total elimination. If the empirical evidence points to anything, it points towards
paragraphs.translationZh: M）如果学校允许学生运动员为了参加体育比赛而经常错过教学时间，那就糟糕了。然而，通过改变学校和国家有关体育赛事安排的政策而不是彻底消除体育赛事，可以更好地解决这些问题。如果经验证据表明了什么的话，那就是

paragraphs.sourceText: school-sponsored sports providing assets that are well worth the costs.
paragraphs.translationZh: 学校赞助的体育运动提供了物有所值的资产。

paragraphs.sourceText: N) Despite negative stereotypes about sports culture and Ripley’s presumption that academics and athletics are at odds with one another, we believe that the greater body of evidence shows that school-sponsored sports programs appear to benefit students. Successes on the playing field can carry over to the classroom and vice versa (反之亦然）. More importantly, finding ways to increase school communities’ social capital is imperative to the success of the school as a whole, not just the athletes.
paragraphs.translationZh: N) 尽管对体育文化存在负面刻板印象，而且里普利认为学术和体育是相互矛盾的，但我们相信，更多的证据表明，学校赞助的体育项目似乎对学生有利。赛场上的成功可以延续到课堂上，反之亦然。更重要的是，找到增加学校社区社会资本的方法对于整个学校的成功至关重要，而不仅仅是运动员的成功。

paragraphs.sourceText: 46. Students from low-income families have less access to off-campus sports programs.
paragraphs.translationZh: 46. 低收入家庭的学生参加校外体育项目的机会较少。

paragraphs.sourceText: 47. Amanda Ripley argues that America should learn from other countries that rank high in international tests and lay less emphasis on athletics.
paragraphs.translationZh: 47. 阿曼达·里普利 (Amanda Ripley) 认为，美国应该向其他在国际测试中排名靠前的国家学习，而不那么重视体育运动。

paragraphs.sourceText: 48. According to the author, Amanda Ripley fails to note that students’ performance in exams varies from state to state.
paragraphs.translationZh: 48. 据作者称，阿曼达·里普利没有注意到学生在考试中的表现因州而异。

paragraphs.sourceText: 49. Amanda Ripley thinks that athletic coaches are poor at classroom instruction.
paragraphs.translationZh: 49. 阿曼达·里普利 (Amanda Ripley) 认为体育教练的课堂教学能力很差。

paragraphs.sourceText: 50. James Coleman’s later research makes an argument for a school’s social capital.

paragraphs.sourceText: 51. Researchers find that there is a positive relationship between a school’s commitment to athletics and academic achievements.

paragraphs.sourceText: Questions 56 to 60 are based on the following passage.
paragraphs.translationZh: 第 56 至 60 题基于以下段落。

paragraphs.sourceText: It is easy to miss amid the day-to-day headlines of global economic recession, but there is a less conspicuous kind of social upheaval (剧变) underway that is fast altering both the face of the planet and the way human beings live. That change is the rapid acceleration of urbanization. In 2008, for the first time in human history, more than half the world’s population was living in towns and cities. And as a recently published paper shows, the process of urbanization will only accelerate in the decades to come-with an enormous impact on biodiversity and potentially on climate change.
paragraphs.translationZh: 在全球经济衰退的日常头条新闻中很容易忽视这一点，但有一种不太引人注目的社会剧变正在发生，它正在迅速改变地球的面貌和人类的生活方式。这种变化就是城市化的快速加速。 2008年，人类历史上首次出现超过一半的世界人口居住在城镇。正如最近发表的一篇论文所示，城市化进程只会在未来几十年内加速，并对生物多样性产生巨大影响，并可能对气候变化产生巨大影响。

paragraphs.sourceText: As Karen Seto, the lead author of the paper, points out, the wave of urbanization isn’t just about the migration of people into urban environments, but about the environments themselves becoming bigger to accommodate all those people. The rapid expansion of urban areas will have a huge impact on biodiversity hotspots and on carbon emissions in those urban areas.
paragraphs.translationZh: 正如该论文的主要作者凯伦·濑户（Karen Seto）所指出的那样，城市化浪潮不仅仅是人们向城市环境的迁移，而且是环境本身变得更大以容纳所有这些人。城市地区的快速扩张将对生物多样性热点地区和城市地区的碳排放产生巨大影响。

paragraphs.sourceText: Humans are the ultimate invasive species—when they move into new territory, they often displace the wildlife that was already living there. And as land is cleared for those new cities —especially in the dense tropical forests—carbon will be released into the atmosphere as well. It’s true that as people in developing nations move from the countryside to the city, the shift may reduce the pressure on land, which could in turn be good for the environment. This is especially so in desperately poor countries, where residents in the countryside slash and burn forests each growing season to clear space for farming. But the real difference is that in developing nations, the move from rural areas to cities often leads to an accompanying increase in income —and that increase leads to an increase in the consumption of food and energy, which in turn causes a rise in carbon emissions. Getting enough to eat and enjoying the safety and comfort of living fully on the grid is certainly a good thing —but it does carry an environmental price.
paragraphs.translationZh: 人类是终极入侵物种——当他们进入新的领地时，他们常常会取代已经生活在那里的野生动物。随着这些新城市的土地被清理——特别是在茂密的热带森林中——碳也将被释放到大气中。确实，随着发展中国家的人们从农村迁移到城市，这种转变可能会减轻对土地的压力，这反过来又对环境有利。在极度贫穷的国家尤其如此，那里的农村居民在每个生长季节都会砍伐和焚烧森林，以腾出耕作空间。但真正的区别在于，在发展中国家，从农村地区迁移到城市往往会导致收入随之增加，而这种增加会导致食品和能源消耗的增加，进而导致碳排放的增加。获得足够的食物并享受完全依靠电网生活的安全和舒适当然是一件好事，但它确实付出了环境代价。

paragraphs.sourceText: The urbanization wave can’t be stopped —and it shouldn’t be. But Seto’s paper does underscore the importance of managing that transition. If we do it the right way, we can reduce urbanization’s impact on the environment. “There’s an enormous opportunity here, and a lot of pressure and responsibility to think about how we urbanize,” says Seto. “One thing that’s clear is that we can’t build cities the way we have over the last couple of hundred years. The scale of this transition won’t allow that. ” We’re headed towards an urban planet no matter what, but whether it becomes heaven or hell is up to us. 注意：此部分试题请在答题卡2 上作答。
paragraphs.translationZh: 城市化浪潮无法阻挡——也不应该被阻挡。但濑户的论文确实强调了管理这种转变的重要性。如果我们采取正确的方式，我们就可以减少城市化对环境的影响。 “这里有巨大的机会，但思考我们如何城市化也面临着很大的压力和责任，”濑户说。 “有一点是明确的，我们不能像过去几百年那样建造城市。这种转变的规模不允许这样做。”无论如何，我们都在走向一个城市星球，但它是成为天堂还是地狱取决于我们。

paragraphs.sourceText: Questions 61 to 65 are based on the following passage.
paragraphs.translationZh: 第 61 至 65 题基于以下段落。

paragraphs.sourceText: When Harvard student Mark Zuckerberg launched thefacebook. com in Feb. 2004, even he could not imagine the forces it would let loose. His intent was to connect college students. Facebook, which is what this website rapidly evolved into, ended up connecting the world.
paragraphs.translationZh: 当哈佛大学学生马克·扎克伯格推出 Facebook 时。 2004 年 2 月，当他在 2004 年 2 月的时候，他也无法想象它会释放出怎样的力量。他的目的是连接大学生。 Facebook，也就是这个网站迅速发展起来的，最终连接了世界。

paragraphs.sourceText: To the children of this connected era, the world is one giant social network. They are not bound —as were previous generations of humans 一by what they were taught. They are only limited by their curiosity and ambition. During my childhood, all knowledge was local. You learned everything you knew from your parents, teachers, preachers, and friends.
paragraphs.translationZh: 对于这个互联时代的孩子们来说，世界就是一个巨大的社交网络。他们不像前几代人类那样，不受所学知识的束缚。他们仅受好奇心和野心的限制。在我的童年时期，所有的知识都是本地的。你从父母、老师、牧师和朋友那里学到了你所知道的一切。

paragraphs.sourceText: With the high-quality and timely information at their fingertips, today’s children are rising above the fears and biases of their parents. Adults are also participating in this revolution. India’s normally tame middle class is speaking up against social ills. Silicon Valley executives are being shamed into adding women to their boards. Political leaders are marshalling the energy of millions for elections and political causes. All of this is being done with social media technologies that Facebook and its competitors set free.
paragraphs.translationZh: 凭借触手可及的高质量和及时的信息，今天的孩子们正在超越父母的恐惧和偏见。成年人也参与到这场革命中。一向温顺的印度中产阶级正在大声疾呼反对社会弊病。硅谷高管因在董事会中增加女性而感到羞愧。政治领导人正在为选举和政治事业聚集数百万人的精力。所有这一切都是通过 Facebook 及其竞争对手免费提供的社交媒体技术来完成的。

paragraphs.sourceText: As does every advancing technology, social media has created many new problems. It is commonly addictive and creates risks for younger users. Social media is used by extremists in the Middle East and elsewhere to seek and brainwash recruits. And it exposes us and our friends to disagreeable spying. We may leave our lights on in the house when we are on vacation, but through social media we tell criminals exactly where we are, when we plan to return home, and how to blackmail（敲诈）us.
paragraphs.translationZh: 正如每项先进技术一样，社交媒体也带来了许多新问题。它通常会让人上瘾，并给年轻用户带来风险。中东和其他地方的极端分子利用社交媒体寻找新成员并对其进行洗脑。这让我们和我们的朋友面临令人讨厌的间谍活动。当我们度假时，我们可能会把家里的灯开着，但通过社交媒体，我们可以准确地告诉犯罪分子我们在哪里，我们计划何时回家，以及如何敲诈我们。

paragraphs.sourceText: Governments don’t need informers any more. Social media allows government agencies to spy on their own citizens. We record our thoughts, emotions, likes and dislikes on Facebook；we share our political views, social preferences, and plans. We post intimate photographs of ourselves. No spy agency or criminal organization could actively gather the type of data that we voluntarily post for them.
paragraphs.translationZh: 政府不再需要告密者。社交媒体允许政府机构监视本国公民。我们在 Facebook 上记录我们的想法、情绪、好恶；我们分享我们的政治观点、社会偏好和计划。我们发布自己的亲密照片。任何间谍机构或犯罪组织都无法主动收集我们自愿为他们发布的此类数据。

paragraphs.sourceText: The marketers are also seeing big opportunities. Amazon is trying to predict what we will order. Google is trying to judge our
paragraphs.translationZh: 营销人员也看到了巨大的机会。亚马逊正在尝试预测我们会订购什么。谷歌正在试图判断我们的

paragraphs.sourceText: needs and wants based on our social-media profiles. We need to be aware of the risks and keep working to alleviate the dangers.
paragraphs.translationZh: 基于我们的社交媒体资料的需求和愿望。我们需要认识到风险并继续努力减轻危险。

paragraphs.sourceText: Regardless of what social media people use, one thing is certain：we are in a period of accelerating change. The next decade will be even more amazing and unpredictable than the last. Just as no one could predict what would happen with social media in the last decade, no one can accurately predict where this technology will take us. I am optimistic, however, that a connected humanity will find a way to uplift itself. 注意：此部分试题请在答题卡2 上作答。
paragraphs.translationZh: 无论人们使用什么社交媒体，有一点是肯定的：我们正处于一个加速变革的时期。下一个十年将比上一个十年更加令人惊奇和难以预测。正如没有人能够预测过去十年社交媒体会发生什么一样，没有人能够准确预测这项技术将带我们走向何方。然而，我乐观地认为，相互联系的人类将找到提升自我的方法。
